events.text: Phase 1/5 landed (7e01f4fe6): combined painter surface — one editor shader composes tiles+roads+height+zones with per-channel emphasis; ChunkSurface layer switch removed.
Phase 2/5 landed: capability registry + one input overlay (resolver in painterBehavior.ts); erase-everywhere (objects under brush, road stroke under click); universal most-specific select.
Phase 3/5 landed: PainterRail of composable cards (universal ToolCard, shared BrushCard, per-target cards, any-target ObjectInspectorCard); BrushRail/PlaceRail/RoadRail monoliths dissolved.
Phase 4/5 landed: TargetDock channel chips (active + eye visibility, persisted per map); shader emphasis + ghost/wire overlays follow the channel eyes.

resolution: Rebuilt PaintCanvas into ONE Painter per the user's proposal, all five phases landed. (1) Combined chunk shader: painterView.wgsl.ts + encodePainterSurface compose tile ground, analytic road ribbon, height tint/contours, and zone tint on every chunk quad with per-channel emphasis — painting any target now SEES every other channel (the main ask); the game's HEIGHTFIELD_TILE_SHADER + CPU mirror untouched; every buffer section always emits explicit headers (GHOSTROAD-0610). (2) One input overlay driven by a pure resolver (stroke|click|select|none; none keeps native object drag) + a per-target capability table replacing the layer if-chains; erase works everywhere (terrain lowers, objects delete under the brush, road strokes delete on click); Select is universal and most-specific (object→build→road→cell). (3) One PainterRail of composable cards (universal ToolCard Select/Paint/Erase, shared BrushCard, per-target cards, selection-driven inspector on any target). (4) TargetDock channel chips (TILE/ROAD/TERRAIN/OBJECT/ZONE, persisted Layer values unchanged) with eye toggles persisted per map; dim landmark rules for ghosts + road wires under the 512-children cap. (5) P4 suite editors/world/painter.test.ts 3/3 green; viewrunaway 2/2 + mapload 7/7 still green; docs/game/hmsc-int.md + _index record updated. Bundle-checked every phase; needs the user's eyes in the live editor for the visual emphasis weights.
